findings.statement: CA9 ranks 1 in the convergence ranking. In tumor scRNA-seq the RCC cell group holds 0.976 of tissue transcripts (54.7% of cells expressing, cpm_share 0.958), so the bulk signal is tumor-intrinsic.
Paired by donor, CA9 in tumor cells vs proximal tubule has log2fc 7.739 (padj 0.0189, 6 donors); the purity-extrapolated RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 7.787, so the signal survives purity adjustment.

In Visium, CA9 high spots are surrounded by RCC (log2 enrichment 0.377, padj 0.00173; observed neighbor share 0.4751 vs expected 0.3658). The composition-corrected in-situ share is 0.998 for RCC, so the signal is tumor-cell centred. Enrichment for macrophage neighbors is only 0.084.

The best MGD site on CA9 scores 0.546 but is a small pocket (126.8 A3, depth 2.55, mean pLDDT 90.3) with one accessible lysine. Ligand-site recall is 0.5 (recall_in_top_pockets 0.221), so the site is only moderately supported. This is a site ranking, not evidence that a glue exists.
KDR transcripts are endothelial (share 0.951, cpm_share 0.979, 40.5% of endothelial cells expressing). KDR is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target, not a tumor-cell target.

CD74 is expressed by myeloid and lymphoid cells, not tumor cells: cDC (100% expressing, cpm_share 0.311) and macrophage (99.5% expressing, transcript share 0.436). Any bulk CD74 increase reflects infiltrating immune cells.
CXCR4 is carried by lymphocytes: CD4 T (87.8% expressing) and CD8 T (72.9% expressing, transcript share 0.563). It is an immune-compartment marker, not tumor-intrinsic.
MET is mostly tumor-cell: the RCC group holds 0.935 of transcripts (35.2% expressing, cpm_share 0.682), with a smaller endothelial component (12% expressing, cpm_share 0.283).

CD70 ranks 3 in convergence (TCGA log2fc 7.09, RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 4.278), supporting tumor-intrinsic expression. It has clinical-stage antibodies (cusatuzumab Phase 2, vorsetuzumab mafodotin Phase 1). The scRNA record carries no evidence id and CD70 is not covered by Visium, so cell-type share is not quoted here.

NNMT ranks 7 in convergence: tumor-intrinsic (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 5.256, TCGA log2fc 4.685) with a TCGA cox log HR of 0.301 (padj 0.00479). No AlphaFold pocket analysis is available, so MGD tractability is untested.

SCARB1 ranks 5 in convergence with RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.762. By scRNA, per-cell expression is highest in endothelium (24.5% expressing, cpm_share 0.406) rather than RCC (15.5% expressing, cpm_share 0.194), so part of the signal is stromal.

COL23A1 is a first-in-class opportunity in the tumor track (novelty 0.839): RCC holds 0.881 of tumor transcripts, RNA log2fc 4.07, protein log2fc 2.51, 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, surface or secreted, max vital-organ nTPM 3 (heart muscle). Its AlphaFold model is weak (mean pLDDT 58.91) and its only pocket is tiny (8.0 A3, MGD score 0.2342), so it is not a glue candidate. Caveat: no dependency evidence and literature counted by gene symbol.

RAB42 is an under-studied tumor-cell candidate (novelty 0.775): RCC holds 0.627 of tumor transcripts, RNA log2fc 3.11, protein log2fc 1.9, 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, max vital-organ nTPM 2.6 (lung). The model is confident (mean pLDDT 85.31); top MGD site 0.5348, but the pocket is small (37.4 A3) with 3 accessible lysines and ligand validation was not checked. Caveat: no functional dependency evidence.

LRRC25 is an immune-track candidate (novelty 0.704) carried by macrophages (share 0.787), with 0 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, and protein log2fc 1.48. It would be a microenvironment target, and bone marrow expression (31 nTPM) is an off-tumor risk. Caveat: literature counted by gene symbol, no functional evidence.

GAL3ST4 is a macrophage-attributed candidate (share 0.972, novelty 0.711) with 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug, antibody tractable, max vital-organ nTPM 7.4 (cerebral cortex). It is a microenvironment hypothesis, not a validated target.

HMCN1 is a stroma-track candidate (novelty 0.559) with endothelial transcript share 0.719, 8 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, and max vital-organ nTPM 19.4 (lung). Its tumor RNA log2fc is only 1.13, so the effect is modest; it is a stromal hypothesis.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses with no dependency or functional evidence; literature is counted by gene symbol.
MGD scores rank sites only; pockets are small, ligand-site recall is limited or not checked, and no glue is claimed.
scRNA has few donors for some cell groups (e.g. endothelial 5, pDC 2), so cell-type shares are approximate.
CD70 and NNMT scRNA records have no evidence ids, so their cell-type numbers are not quoted.
